**Best value: ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400 W panel kit** — listed at **$698** with **1 kWh of LiFePO₄ storage**, an **1,800 W inverter**, and a full **400 W panel**. That’s a strong bundle for keeping essentials going during an outage, though 1 kWh is modest for extended backup. The listing says it’s a preorder shipping **Dec. 7**, so confirm availability before ordering. [Check the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit) · [See the listing details](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup)

If you need something sooner, the listing also names the **BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W panel kit** at **$729** as the alternative, with stock expected in late November. [Check the BLUETTI kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit)

Neither is a whole-house solution; think essential devices, not central heating or air conditioning. [Under-$1,000 backup overview](https://www.haynet.net/best-solar-generators-under-1000-dollars/)
